items.action: Pin Dockerfile SDK to verified sha256:212fe4cb74627d5adf9817a4088906ae3edff1bd853bb27565d4b46731efe61e; record actual client/server image identities.
Owner build-only restore extracts packages.lock.json, add source lock plus --locked-mode, then perform canonical runtime on final unchanged source. First build is not DB execution.

Track captured transaction IDs in sys.dm_tran_active_transactions in addition to session-transactions and active snapshot views, so loss of session mapping cannot by itself certify transaction end. Add permission probe and explicit documentation.

Initial build reported NU1902/NU1903 for transitive Pkcs9.0.18. Add direct pinned10.0.14, which exceeds patched10.0.13 per Microsoft advisories; make NuGet vulnerability warnings fail build. Preserve initial build logs.
Fresh30second cleanup token via AsyncLocal, independent of the canceled work/global token. Attach lifetime bound extended to240seconds to permit cleanup after work expiry.
